summary: Pass 2 verification of iteration_5 fixes for BeezTrace/Koster Keunen MIS (frontend-only, direct Supabase). CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) ContractDetail page now loads full content (header/product table/totals) for both contracts (NQQ76O0IP4, 0LJS1WIODY) as Admin-acting-as-Chinedu-Okafor, Admin-acting-as-Amina-Yusuf, AND as Member (member.test) — root cause (PostgREST embed ambiguity, actors!actor_id) genuinely resolved, no more stuck-Loading or false not-found. (2) Update contract modal: per-line qty/price fields render pre-filled with real values (e.g. 8,000 / 3,000), invalid qty (0 or negative) shows inline 'invalid quantity' error and disables Submit, Advance amount paid field formats to 2 decimals on blur (1234.5 -> 1234.50). (3) /report page loads without errors as Admin; clicking into 'Contract' report tab (under Transactions) navigates to /contracts and shows the real 2-contract dataset with no errors, confirming the report aggregate fix. (4) TransactionDetail loads full content for an existing Approved Received transaction (R151TVPPB7) — no stuck Loading, no false empty state. (5) Bulk upload of a non-xlsx (.json) file in Received > Multiple mode now shows inline error 'Unsupported file type. Please upload an .xlsx file.' via data-testid=receive-bulk-parse-error, NO React dev error overlay, page remains fully usable. (6) Beekeepers list headers now show real text 'Total hives' / 'Active years' (verified for Chinedu Okafor actor context). (7) Navigating to /send/new now redirects to /transactions/send/new correctly (shows Send stock form) instead of bouncing to dashboard. NOT COMPLETED: full new-Received-transaction create->Approve->stock-increase and create->Reject lifecycle — blocked by the beekeeper searchable-combobox returning 0 selectable options across all 4 tested villages (Atacora, Kwara Central, Bono, Cinkasse-not reached) under the Chinedu Okafor actor context, and Submit stays disabled without a beekeeper selected (same interaction difficulty flagged in iteration_5, now compounded by apparent lack of beekeeper-per-village data for this actor). NEW BUG FOUND: Sharing round-trip — submitting the 'Share access' form (email=member.test@beeztrace.test, module=Contracts/Commercial partners, permission=View) closes the modal with no error message/toast, but the 'Shared by me' list remains 'You haven't shared access with anyone yet.' even after a full page reload — the share is not actually persisted. No console errors or inline error elements were observed, suggesting a silent failure (possibly Supabase RLS blocking the insert, or the insert succeeding into a table the list query doesn't read from, or a missing refetch — but a full reload rules out a pure refetch bug). Did not proceed to recipient login step since the source-side share never appeared.

rca_of_the_issue: Sharing bug: form submit -> modal closes cleanly (implies the async submit handler completed without throwing) but 'Shared by me' list is unchanged after a hard reload -> read-after-write consistency fails. Most likely: (a) Supabase RLS policy silently rejects the INSERT for this actor/user combination but the client code doesn't check/surface the PostgREST error response, or (b) the insert succeeds but into a row scoped to the wrong actor_id (e.g. writing under the wrong 'My Actor' context — note testing was done while managing Chinedu Okafor, worth re-testing while managing Amina Yusuf or with page reload before opening the modal), or (c) the 'Shared by me' list query has its own filter mismatch analogous to the just-fixed contracts/transactions actor_id ambiguity bug (worth checking if a shares/permissions table also has multiple actor-related FKs).
